### U.S. News & World Report Again Names DHI Group One of the Best Companies to Work For


June 30, 2026


CENTENNIAL, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


**DHI Group, Inc. (NYSE: DHX)** , owner of the ClearanceJobs and Dice brands, announced today that it has been recognized as one of[U.S. News & World Report](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcareers.usnews.com%2Fcompanies%2Fdhi-group-27942084&esheet=54562722&newsitemid=20260630971385&lan=en-US&anchor=U.S.+News+%26+World+Report&index=286&md5=17149615a8f50d408c151abe77ddc30f) 's Best Companies to Work For, underscoring the company's ongoing commitment to fostering an exceptional workplace culture and employee experience.


DHI Group Inc. named one of US News & World Report's Best Places to Work


The annual recognition honors organizations that demonstrate excellence in workplace quality and employee experience. Using an independent methodology, U.S. News evaluates companies across key areas including compensation and benefits, work-life balance, job stability, employee well-being, and career growth opportunities. DHI Group received the highest score in three key areas: quality of pay, work life balance, and comfort.


"I am thrilled to share that DHI Group has once again been named a Best Company to Work for by U.S. News & World Report," said Art Zeile, Chief Executive Officer of DHI Group. "What makes this recognition especially meaningful is how it's determined. Companies don't apply, submit data, or pay a fee to be considered. U.S. News bases their rankings entirely on publicly available data—employee reviews, financial strength, governance, and more. The fact that we've earned this recognition again speaks to the consistency of our culture year after year.”


DHI Group's "One Team" philosophy emphasizes collaboration, transparency, innovation, and shared success across the organization. The company empowers employees to make meaningful contributions while supporting their professional growth and well-being. That culture helps drive DHI's mission of connecting technology professionals and security-cleared talent with career opportunities through its industry-leading brands, Dice and ClearanceJobs.


"This recognition reinforces what we've long believed—that our people are our greatest strength," said Zeile. "By investing in our employees and maintaining a culture built on trust, collaboration, and purpose, we're able to better serve our customers, partners, and the communities we support."


To learn more about career opportunities at DHI Group, visit the company's[careers page](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fdhigroupinc.com%2Fcareers%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54562722&newsitemid=20260630971385&lan=en-US&anchor=careers+page&index=287&md5=aec0aa045abbf255cfb12bdfbb14bfb2) .


**DHI Group, Inc. – About Us**


DHI Group, Inc (NYSE: DHX) is a provider of AI-powered career marketplaces that focus on technology roles. DHI’s two brands, ClearanceJobs and Dice, enable recruiters and hiring managers to efficiently search for and connect with highly skilled technology professionals based on the skills requested. The Company’s patented algorithm manages over 100,000 unique technology skills. Additionally, our marketplaces allow tech professionals to find their ideal next career opportunity, with relevant advice and personalized insights. Learn more at[www.dhigroupinc.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.dhigroupinc.com&esheet=54562722&newsitemid=20260630971385&lan=en-US&anchor=www.dhigroupinc.com&index=288&md5=10443e494aeae4427be07f55a7e40969) .
